setupInstructions: Confirm the sign-in method and your account role with First Form before using this guide.
Use the confirmed permanent login address and the setup instructions supplied for your account.
Practise one agreed website task together during the handover.

tasks.title: Request a content update
steps: Illustrative task: identify the page and describe the change you need.
Prepare the approved wording and any image files you are permitted to use.
Use the support route agreed for your service and confirm whether the work is included before it starts.
tasks.confirmation: Review the agreed change on the website when First Form tells you it is ready.

tasks.title: Choose a brand asset
steps: Illustrative task: open the DDC North brand kit supplied with the handover.
Choose the supplied logo variant for the background and intended use.
Keep its proportions and follow the clear-space and minimum-size guidance in the kit.
tasks.confirmation: Check that the complete logo is visible and the supplied colours are preserved.

tasks.title: Check a form if included
steps: Illustrative task for a website with a form: confirm whether this feature is included.
Send an agreed test enquiry using non-sensitive sample text.
Check the agreed delivery destination and confirm who will respond to enquiries.
tasks.confirmation: Replace this example with the actual form and delivery instructions after the workflow is confirmed.

services.name: Managed website platform
services.managedBy: First Form in this illustrative example

services.name: Domain and DNS
services.scope: Record domain registration, DNS management and renewal responsibilities separately from the managed website platform.

services.name: Content changes
services.scope: Record which edits the client can make, which changes First Form handles, and how additional work is agreed.

services.name: Website enquiries if included
services.scope: Optional example service. Confirm whether forms are included, where enquiries go and who manages their data.

assets.note: Example delivery address. The client artwork is separate from First Form's provider identity. Use the actual supplied kit and its asset catalogue when issuing.
